# Basant Bhattarai

> Senior Data & AI Engineer · Platform Architect · Full-Stack
> Kathmandu, Nepal · Collaborates with US and EU teams

## Summary

Builds and operates multi-TB data platforms (Kafka, Spark, Iceberg, dbt, Airflow on Kubernetes), production agentic AI systems (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, Google-ADK, RAG), and full-stack products (FastAPI, Next.js, PostgreSQL/ClickHouse). Track record includes 40% infra cost reduction, 50% faster processing, 60% faster analytics delivery, 99.9% uptime.

## Primary experience

- Senior Data Engineer, UXCam (2024–present): company data platform + analytics agent platform
- Data Engineer, UXCam (2020–2024): lakehouse, streaming quality, Kubernetes migration
- Earlier: project leadership (NLP) and backend/data engineering (FastAPI, PostgreSQL)
